name: Mall Escalator Floor Transition · 2 m
summary: A flush 2 m threshold for the escalator's projecting end beam, with champagne-metal shoulder returns and graphite grip bands.
description: A 120 mm-deep closure bridges the original escalator deck and modular floor. Its underside clears the terminal crossbeam while two metal-faced shoulders finish the exposed 225 mm returns. Graphite strips sit flush with the brushed-steel walking surface.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
creation_method: Original Blender-authored stepped solid with conforming wearing faces, metal returns and integral countersunk fixings.

dimensions.axis_order: glTF X, Y, Z in metres
dimensions.origin: Midpoint of the deck-facing top edge; local +Z points away from the escalator

rights: Owner-project reuse of the original geometry, materials and render is authorized. Public download and redistribution terms are unspecified.
accuracy_notes: Static illustrative joint. Install at the measured outer deck edge. The escalator motion, passenger behaviour, load capacity and construction compliance are outside this asset's measurements.

attribution.credit: Original geometry, materials and studio render by the Blender-3D-Gallery project. The recess is dimensioned from its existing escalator and two-metre floor slab.
